title: Hake Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with tender hake, fresh vegetables, and a hint of Greek flair.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add tomato paste and stir for 1 minute, until absorbed.
Add Greek olives, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add hake fillets and pour in the dense red wine.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then cover and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
